items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I introduced it. I introduced it. ... Mike Jackson brought in songs to me.

ctx.x: Now, who was Mike Jackson, with whom you (Inaudible)?

Mike Jackson was a piano player, and he wrote a lot of songs. He was in Chicago, Mike Jackson. He wrote a lot of good songs, and I didn't know -- and he never did get any credit for them. I think he sold most all of them for a few dollars.

Well, you recorded with him for Victor -- 'I'll Forgive You Because I Love You,' 'I'm Going to Lose Myself Way Down in Louisville,' 'My Old Daddy's Got a Brand New Way to Love,' and 'I'm Down Right Now, But I Won't be Down Always.'
